reason: Both conversations correctly reassure the homeowner that gurgling (refrigerant flow), clicks (thermostat/compressor switching) and cracks (thermal expansion) are normal operating noises, make no unsupported claims about leaks, compressors, engineers or parts, and condition the reassurance on cooling being fine. Neither asks the sensible follow-ups about level, clearance or any loud buzzing/grinding, and neither mentions when to contact Bosch under warranty. Conversation 1 explicitly links the cracks to the defrost cycle, but its 'warm to the touch' fault test is misleading since fridge exteriors legitimately run warm; Conversation 2's 'sections getting cold' check is sounder but its explanation is slightly less complete, so the two net out equal.
